name: Slithering Snakes
disable: DC 31 Acrobatics check (expert) to approach the desk without triggering the trap, followed by DC 33 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune; conversely, Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rune

items.name: Slither
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the desk

---
Effect The hazard rolls initiative. On its turn, shadowy snakes appear throughout the room, filling the area with the effect of a 6th-rank Slither spell (DC 34) for 1 minute.

text: A black, snake-shaped rune summons sinuous, shadowy serpents to grab and bite intruders throughout the room.
